label: def:has_deriv_at
title: Has derivative at a point
statement: Let $F : \mathbb{F} \to \mathbb{F}$ where $\mathbb{F}$ is a nontrivially normed field. We say $F$ \emph{has derivative} $f'$ \emph{at} $x$ if the Fr\'echet derivative of $F$ at $x$ exists and equals scalar multiplication by $f'$, i.e., $F(x + h) = F(x) + f' \cdot h + o(h)$ as $h \to 0$. In Mathlib this is \texttt{HasDerivAt}.
